LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SOCIALISING AND TAKING ACTION: DEBATES AND DISCUSSI

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Which skills do we use to debate?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. use imperative sentences to discuss topics for self-expressions
2. identify debating skills for comprehension
3. appreciate debates and discussions for information sharing and socialisation

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi

Teach
• Focus skill: use imperative sentences to discuss topics for self-expressions.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussi
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which skills do we use to debate?
2. How do we use imperative sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
